name: memory-plan

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec none --prefix-cache off --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: bootstrap: predicted MemAvailable at ready within 1 GiB of measured
bootstrap: guard minimum after the first requests at or above floor 8 GiB + 2 GiB margin
long: predicted MemAvailable at ready within 1 GiB of measured
long: guard minimum after the first requests at or above floor 8 GiB + 2 GiB margin
max-cache-off: predicted MemAvailable at ready within 1 GiB of measured
max-cache-off: guard minimum after the first requests at or above floor 8 GiB + 2 GiB margin
max-cache-auto: predicted MemAvailable at ready within 1 GiB of measured
max-cache-auto: guard minimum after the first requests at or above floor 8 GiB + 2 GiB margin
bootstrap-vision-cache: predicted MemAvailable at ready within 1 GiB of measured
bootstrap-vision-cache: guard minimum after the first requests at or above floor 8 GiB + 2 GiB margin

commands: NODES=node-1 REXL3_SRC=<engine worktree> ./inkling2mini.sh build <40-hex>  (91c05af and 04d4d60: instrumented, old plan; abc6813: new plan)
run_profile.sh LABEL PROFILE=... VISION=... PREFIX_CACHE=...  (start; four chat requests and a completion; status; memwatch report; stop)
notes: Before = the old plan (5 GiB blanket reserve) on the instrumented engine (mem_stage lines only added); its prediction is floor + (5 - 1.125 priced buffers) + spare - cache, the memory the old plan left unspent. After = engine abc681365c70 (the new plan; the capacity line's predicted_ready_available_gib). Measured = MemAvailable the controller read at ready (status-ready.txt); guard-min = status-after-traffic.txt's minimum. Node-1 carried LoopRank's CPU-heavy oracle job: swap grew from 311 to 2022 MiB across these boots (see README).
